title: Login with a wrong clientSecret is the documented 401 ErrorMessage

source.note: The specification's 401 on the login operation says the request's client id and secret did not check out, with ErrorMessage as its schema. The ErrorMessage field set (status, code, message, messageKey, fieldName, link, requestId, developerMessage, errors, canRetry) and the integer status in the body are from the example on apiResponsesAndErrors.html; the specification declares ErrorMessage.status as type string, which that example contradicts, so this case asserts the example's integer. The body's message wording is not documented and is asserted as any string.
